attributes.has_name: Verify processing fault response and detection timing
attributes.task_description: Inject processing, communication, scheduling, and timestamp faults. Verify detection integrity and bounded warning or safe-state response for each injected fault.

Verify TDS_SAF_006: startup, channel-loss and controller faults produce the correct visual and distinct acoustic unavailable indications within the allocated timing budget. Check recovery qualification and prevent a stale running indication.

Verify the newly specified TDS_SEN_005 channel-loss detection, status freshness and propagation to degraded state. Confirm worst-case timing and inject acquisition/monitoring implementation faults; requirements are now present but evidence is still open.
Define test to verify alarm stays within L_alarm_min to L_alarm_max.
